name: Nikuya
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional neighborhood butcher shop, Fuji Seinikuten: a meat sale notice, a first day working part-time at the shop, a guide to ordering meat, a day practicing how to cut meat, a sukiyaki meat reservation order guide, a column on how cutting technique changes taste, a day teaching a new junior how to take orders, an explainer on why hand-cut meat is still needed in the era of slicing machines, a meat storage and expiry-date guide, a column on how an online/reservation ordering system changed customer service work, a new rule for year-end sukiyaki-meat special order handling, a column on the meaning of a veteran shop owner's skill for judging meat quality, and a one-year cooperation report with a local elementary school's food-education program. Original texts, answers with the reason for every choice.
